category: geocoding gazetteer data download and search software

free_tier.stated: a pre-generated planet gazetteer of over 21 million place names as a gzip-compressed TSV, 1.34 GB on the download page (1,437,702,497 bytes by a ranged read), free to use in projects, products and research, with no account
free_tier.notes: the data is a file, not a query service: geocoding against it needs a search server that the user installs and runs; the hosted autocomplete endpoint at osmnames.org takes a key parameter whose issuer and quota are unverified

per_object_cap.stated: one planet file of 1,437,702,497 bytes (the v2.0.4 planet-latest_geonames.tsv.gz that the download page links); country and bounding-box extracts are cut from it with zcat and awk

retention.stated: static release files on GitHub Releases with no expiry stated; the newest release holds OpenStreetMap data of 2022-11-25

egress.terms: not applicable: static release files with no download limit published

interface_detail: HTTPS download of planet-latest_geonames.tsv.gz from GitHub Releases; a ranged read of the first 1,024 bytes answered HTTP 206 with no account; the project's search server speaks an autocomplete form /q/<query>.js?key=<key> and an incomplete Nominatim-compatible API
tooling: curl or wget, zcat and awk or any TSV tool for the data file; for geocoding the user installs and runs the open-source OSMNames search server (the klokantech/osmnames-sphinxsearch Docker image, or the Flask service with SphinxSearch) on a rented or free machine
chaining: the no-account route to a global place-name gazetteer with bounding boxes, ranks and administrative hierarchy, for bulk matching or for a search index that the user builds; geocoding queries need a server that the user installs and runs, so a hosted geocoder with a free allowance comes first and this is the last resort
binding_note: static files with no published download limit

identity_cost.detail: no account; public downloads from GitHub Releases

reliability_note: the newest release, v2.2.0, holds OpenStreetMap data of 2022-11-25 with no housenumbers, and the download page links the older v2.0.4 file; the pages state no refresh schedule
confidence_note: the download page, the API page, the docs, the about page and the releases page were quoted on 2026-11-02, and a ranged read of the planet file answered HTTP 206 with a total size of 1,437,702,497 bytes. The whole file was not downloaded, so its content was not checked.
